description:
Acer Finally Released The Predator Atlas 8 Gaming Handheld, The Acer Predator Atlas 8 has finally landed in the US! In this video, we unbox, benchmark, and test out Acer's new contender to the ROG Ally, Legion Go, and MSI Claw. Powered by the Intel Arc G3 Extreme (14-core CPU) and the Intel Arc B390 iGPU with 12 Xe3 cores, this handheld packs an 8-inch 120Hz VRR IPS display, 24GB of fast LPDDR5X RAM, an 80Wh battery, and up to a 40W manual TDP mode. We take a deep dive into the PredatorSense software, run synthetic benchmarks against the Ryzen Z2 Extreme, and test out AAA games
